claims.sentence: You must submit your application and all attached documents no later than one month before the university's established start date of the academic year
You submit a personal application addressed to the director of the university to the university structural unit responsible for admissions
When you submit the application, you must present a document that verifies your identity
You must also complete a consent form for the processing of your personal data in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ dated 27.07.2006 "On Personal Data"
The university uses this consent to enter your information into federal, regional, and municipal information systems
Your application must include the following documents
A copy of your education document or your education and qualification document

A copy of a certificate (or copies of certificates) of your study period, confirming successful completion of previous interim certifications at other educational organizations, if you are studying in the form of self-education
A 3x4 cm photograph
Any other documents whose submission serves your interests as a person wishing to be enrolled as an extern
The university's examination commission reviews your submitted documents and makes a decision on your possibility of enrollment
The commission's decision is formalized in a protocol
Based on the examination commission's protocol, the university signs a contract for paid educational services with you as an extern
The university then issues an order enrolling you as an extern to pass the interim and state final certification
The evidence does not specify the exact address or contact details of the structural unit responsible for admissions
It does not state the timeline for the examination commission to review the documents or issue the protocol
It does not specify the cost, payment terms, or duration of the paid educational services contract
It does not explain what happens if the examination commission denies enrollment
It does not provide details on how to submit the application (in person, online, by mail) beyond the requirement to present an ID
It does not mention any deadlines for signing the contract or paying fees after the order is issued
